content.title: Roblox is using AI to address safety concerns, CEO explains
content.description:
Roblox (RBLX) has been at the center of child safety concerns, even facing lawsuits alleging an unsafe environment for underage users.

Roblox CEO Dave Baszucki joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss how the company is leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to address safety concerns.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.

content.summary: Shares of companies in the tech sector led the decline in the wake of quarterly earnings from Meta Platforms and Microsoft.  Meta Platforms  missed analysts’ third-quarter earnings expectations and the stock declined 11%.  Meta said the earnings miss included a one-time tax charge of $15.93 billion from the implementation of the Trump administration’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
